name: Import Sort on Save
description: Automatically sorts and organizes imports after file modification using the project's import sorting configuration
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Sort imports after file write/edit
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  # Try eslint with import sort plugin
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/.eslintrc" || -f "$ROOT/.eslintrc.js" || -f "$ROOT/.eslintrc.json" || -f "$ROOT/eslint.config.js" ]]; then
    npx eslint --fix --rule 'sort-imports: warn' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    echo "Sorted imports: $FILE"
  fi
fi
exit 0
